purpose: The assistant's delete tool: anything the owner says to delete/remove/get rid of goes to the Windows Recycle Bin (recoverable), with gates and a proof it is in the bin.
owner_approval: never a permanent delete or emptying the bin (the owner's call)
never anything under a folder named in WIPE_PROTECTED
evaluation: recycle.py dry run refuses wildcards and protected paths; --execute ends RECYCLE CLEAN only when every path is gone from disk and listed in the Recycle Bin.

provenance.source: adapted from an earlier skill; reworked here
provenance.license: unspecified (the repo owner picks one before publishing)

portability: Windows-only (Recycle Bin via PowerShell Microsoft.VisualBasic); on Linux swap the mover for a trash-spec (gio trash) call.
